$comment: Node binaries the desktop app may download, and the disk figures its pre-flight check uses. Reviewed by the maintainer on 2026-11-06 (URLs official; SHA-256s match the GitHub release digests; Nimbus SHA-512s match the release notes). A binary is executed only if its archive matches sha256 (and, for Nimbus, the extracted binary also matches the sha512 Nimbus publishes). Nothing here updates automatically.

nethermind.license: GPL-3.0 and LGPL-3.0 (LICENSE-GPL, LICENSE-LGPL in the repository)
nethermind.checksumSource: GitHub release asset digest (SHA-256) for each file on the official release

nimbus.checksumSource: GitHub release asset digest (SHA-256) for the archive; SHA-512 of nimbus_beacon_node from the release notes

disk.$comment: GB (10^9 bytes). Execution figures: Nethermind's per-directory database sizes measured on 2.2.0 (https://docs.nethermind.io/fundamentals/database#database-size), keeping only state, headers, code and blobs because Selfnode disables historical bodies/receipts (Sync.DownloadBodiesInFastSync/DownloadReceiptsInFastSync = false). Consensus: Nimbus hardware requirements (https://nimbus.guide/hardware.html). Growth: Nethermind state-pruning docs ('increases by around 30 GB each week', https://docs.nethermind.io/fundamentals/state-pruning).
